+---

+- 01M376J35YTN5ZDS4GF89F9TAG

+- 01M376KBXZPH1WESVB084SCRS7
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '9980'
+title: IntegrationTests package with real small models
+---
+## What
+Plan.md §15 (integration suite). A nested `IntegrationTests/` package, Swift Testing, `.serialized`, gated by an environment variable, with small `mlx-community` models. Look at `../FoundationModelsRouter/IntegrationTests/` for the gate and the model choice.
+
+- Create `IntegrationTests/Package.swift` (path dependency on `..`) and `IntegrationTests/Tests/AgentsIntegrationTests/`:
+  - `LiveSourcesTests.swift`: a local file, a git-marketplace plugin, and a `file://` folder each become a live sub-agent.
+  - `LiveSlotTests.swift`: the flash model reference runs on the flash slot; two slots overlap.
+  - `FullCircleTests.swift`: the root calls `start agent`, the sub-agent uses a tool, the final message is in the root transcript, the next turn reads it, and `check agent` gives the same text.
+  - `LiveNestedTests.swift`: `agentSpawn` links three sessions; `parentToolCallId` joins to the `start agent` call.
+  - `LiveCommandTests.swift`: a slash command gives its result; `cancel agent` stops a run; a live edit is used by the next delegation while an old run completes.
+- Update `.github/workflows/ci.yml` with the `integration-*` inputs of the shared workflow, and `CIWorkflowTests` to match.
+- The suite reports "skipped" when the gate variable is absent.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] With the gate variable set on a host with the models, all cases pass.
+- [ ] With the gate variable absent, `swift test` in `IntegrationTests/` reports the suites as skipped and exits 0.
+- [ ] `CIWorkflowTests` passes with the new inputs.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] The five test files above.
+- [ ] Run `cd IntegrationTests && swift test` (no gate). Expected: skipped, exit 0.
+- [ ] Run `cd IntegrationTests && <GATE>=1 swift test` on a model host. Expected: pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
